chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub from Malik ibn Atiyya from Ibn Abi Yafur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

The one who slanders a believer or a female believer with what is not in him, Allah will resurrect him in the clay of Khabal until he exits from what he had said. I said, 'And what is the clay of Khabal?' He said, 'Pus that comes out from the private parts of the prostitutes.'
ai.seo_question: What is the specific punishment for slandering a believer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) warns that false slander (buhtan) against a believer results in a specific physical sign of divine punishment: resurrection in the 'clay of Khabal,' identified as pus from the private parts of prostitutes. This vivid imagery underscores the spiritual impurity of the slanderer, linking the physical manifestation of their sin to the moral corruption of their accusation, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical traditions regarding the consequences of backbiting.
